tools.name: lol_get_champion_analysis
tools.description: Returns detailed champion stats (win/pick/ban rates), optimal builds (items, runes, skills, spells), skill combos, counter matchups, and team synergies for a specific champion and position. MUST call when user mentions any champion, asks for item/skill recommendations, gameplay tips, or matchup strategies. Counter picks available in weak_counters field; each counter includes my_win_rate and counter_win_rate for the head-to-head matchup. Infer position from context if not specified.

champion.description: Champion name in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE Examples: ANNIE, OLAF, GALIO

lang.description: Locale code Examples: ar_AE, cs_CZ, de_DE

tier.description: Rank tier filter for matchup/build stats. Omit for all-tier aggregate (no tier parameter sent upstream). Examples: all, challenger, grandmaster

tools.name: lol_get_summoner_game_detail
tools.description: Returns full match detail (teams, participants, builds, bans) for a specific game id whenever the user drills into a single match. When the question is about one summoner's performance, also pass focus_riot_id ("gameName#tagLine"): the matching participant is flagged is_target=true — read the focused summoner's numbers from the participant row where is_target is true, never from a neighbouring participant. If no unique match is found, no row is flagged and data.game_detail.focus_error explains why.

region.description: Server region code Examples: KR, BR, EUNE

lang.description: Locale code Examples: ar_AE, cs_CZ, de_DE

game_id.description: Unique identifier for the target match.

focus_riot_id.description: Riot ID ('gameName#tagLine') of the summoner the user is asking about. The matching participant gets is_target=true — read that row's numbers; if no unique match is found, data.game_detail.focus_error explains why. Unless game_name/tag_line are given separately, this participant is also the only one keeping op_score_timeline.

game_name.description: Riot ID game name before the "#" of the summoner being investigated (e.g., "Faker" from "Faker#KR1"). Only this participant keeps the minute-by-minute op_score_timeline; other participants' timelines are omitted. When omitted, no participant includes op_score_timeline.

tag_line.description: Riot ID tag line following the "#" (e.g., "KR1" from "Faker#KR1").

tools.name: lol_list_skin_stats_for_champion
tools.description: Lists a champion's skins in popularity rank order. Default ranking is by play count (1 = most played in real matches) — the natural answer for ambiguous popularity questions like "which Aatrox skin is most popular?". Pass sort_by="ownership" ONLY when the user explicitly asks about ownership/possession (e.g., "보유 기준", "가지고 있는 사람 많은 순", "owned by most", "collection-wise", "가장 많이 갖고 있는 스킨"). Internal raw counts are NOT exposed in either mode — only rank position and skin identity. Base skin is always excluded since it inherits every match where no other skin was equipped (play mode) and is universally owned by default (ownership mode).

champion.description: Required. Champion name in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g., AATROX, YASUO). Examples: ANNIE, OLAF, GALIO

lang.description: Locale code used to localize skin names. Examples: ar_AE, cs_CZ, de_DE

sort_by.description: Ranking metric. "play" (default) = how many games each skin was actually played — answers "which skin is most popular?" for ambiguous queries. "ownership" = how many accounts own each skin — use ONLY when the user explicitly mentions ownership/possession ("보유", "owned by most", "collection").

desired_output_fields.title: Output fields to extract
desired_output_fields.description:
Select ONLY from fields below. This is a CLOSED SET. Do NOT invent new field names.

Available fields:
- champion_id
- champion_key
- champion_name
- data[].{rank,skin_id,skin_name}
- lang

Field descriptions:
- data.*.rank: 1-based popularity ranking. Metric depends on sort_by input — 1 = most played (default) or most owned (sort_by=ownership). Internal raw counts are deliberately not exposed.
- data.*.skin_id: Riot skin ID (numeric). Base skin is always excluded from this list.
- data.*.skin_name: Localized skin display name for the requested lang. Null when the name cannot be resolved.

tools.name: lol_esports_list_schedules
tools.description: Returns LoL esports schedules or results. Args: mode="schedule" for future schedules from today, mode="result" for latest completed match results beyond the old 7-day window, optional league such as "lck", "kespa", "ewc", "msi", or "worlds", optional team_name such as "T1", and optional limit up to 50 for result mode. Results include teams, leagues, scores, and match times in ISO 8601 UTC format. Always convert to user's timezone before presenting.

mode.description: Use "schedule" for upcoming/future match schedules from today, or "result" for latest completed match results beyond the old 7-day window.

league.description: Optional LoL esports league/tournament short name such as "lck", "kespa", "ewc", "msi", "worlds", "lpl", "lec", "lta", or "lcp".

team_name.description: Optional esports team name or acronym to filter schedules/results, e.g. "T1", "Gen.G", "HLE", "DK", "BLG", or "G2".

limit.description: Optional maximum completed result matches to return in result mode (default 50, max 50). Ignored in schedule mode.
